arms.H: Fixed deeper policy with reciprocal[C(55,k)C(M,8)] hierarchical fitted weights
arms.U: Same deeper policy with reciprocal C(M,8) uniform fitted weights

joint_primary.exact: For every case, H_exact implies U_exact
joint_primary.cross_arm_exact_equality: Not a correctness invariant; report all four transition counts
joint_primary.complete_failure: Either joint condition false falsifies the joint hypothesis
joint_primary.incomplete: Any cap/missing case/proof/correctness error gives no joint decision
